text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and repeated position statements","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position early and keeps returning to it so the reader always knows where it stands."},{"evidence":"paragraph on distracted driving and human reaction","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay supports its claims with specific details and examples from the article and real-world driving behavior."},{"evidence":"explains why driverless cars worry the writer because they are not truly driverless","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops a line of reasoning by moving from the article’s facts to a clear concern about safety and human takeover."},{"evidence":"counterpoint about benefits followed by concerns","quality":"balance","description":"The essay acknowledges advantages before explaining its objections, which makes the argument feel more thoughtful and credible."},{"evidence":"conclusion restating safety concerns and personal position","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending pulls the argument together by revisiting the main concern and reinforcing the writer’s final judgment."}]}
